When configuring UI elements, choose colors with names like [`labelColor`](https://developer.apple.com/documentation/AppKit/NSColor/labelColor). These semantic colors convey the intended use of the color, rather than specific color values. When you use them for their intended purpose, they render with color values appropriate for the current settings.
